entries.text: Poverty is derived from laziness and a lack of work effort.

text.text: Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.
Slothfulness casteth into a deep sleep; and an idle soul shall suffer hunger.
A slothful man hideth his hand in his bosom, and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.
The sluggard will not plow by reason of the cold; therefore shall he beg in harvest, and have nothing.
The desire of the slothful killeth him; for his hands refuse to labour.
I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;
And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, and nettles had covered the face thereof, and the stone wall thereof was broken down.
Then I saw, and considered it well: I looked upon it, and received instruction.
Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth; and thy want as an armed man.
But this I say, He which soweth sparingly shall reap also sparingly; and he which soweth bountifully shall reap also bountifully.
Neither did we eat any man’s bread for nought; but wrought with labour and travail night and day, that we might not be chargeable to any of you:
Not because we have not power, but to make ourselves an ensample unto you to follow us.
For even when we were with you, this we commanded you, that if any would not work, neither should he eat.
For we hear that there are some which walk among you disorderly, working not at all, but are busybodies.
Now them that are such we command and exhort by our Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

entries.text: He who loves pleasure will become a poor man.

text.text: He that loveth pleasure shall be a poor man: he that loveth wine and oil shall not be rich.

entries.text: Poverty will come to him who refuses instruction and is unwilling to learn.

text.text: Poverty and shame shall be to him that refuseth instruction: but he that regardeth reproof shall be honoured.

entries.text: He who follows empty pursuits will have poverty in plenty.

text.text: He that tilleth his land shall have plenty of bread: but he that followeth after vain persons shall have poverty enough.

entries.text: Idle chatter leads only to poverty.

text.text: In all labour there is profit: but the talk of the lips tendeth only to penury.

entries.text: Poverty will come to the drunkard and the glutton.

text.text: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe a man with rags.

entries.text: He who oppresses the poor to increase his riches will surely come to poverty.

text.text: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.

entries.text: Poverty caused by love of sleep.

text.text: How long wilt thou sleep, O sluggard? when wilt thou arise out of thy sleep?
Yet a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:
So shall thy poverty come as one that travelleth, and thy want as an armed man.
Love not sleep, lest thou come to poverty; open thine eyes, and thou shalt be satisfied with bread.

entries.text: God will not allow the soul of the righteous to famish, but He casts away the substance of the wicked.

text.text: The Lord will not suffer the soul of the righteous to famish: but he casteth away the substance of the wicked.

entries.text: He becomes poor that deals with a slack hand, but into the hand of the diligent comes wealth.

text.text: He becometh poor that dealeth with a slack hand: but the hand of the diligent maketh rich.
